feeds.title: Being Patient
feeds.description: Being Patient is the leading online community for Alzheimer's & dementia patients & caregivers. We examine the latest research and debates on the prevention, treatment, and care of the disease. Join our community and get weekly news, exclusive interviews, guidance from experts, scientific breakthroughs, and stories of hope.

feeds.title: Alzheimer Scotland News
feeds.description: Alzheimer Scotland is Scotland's leading dementia charity - providing information, practical services and emotional support to people with dementia and their carers. Our mission is to provide and to secure the provision of high quality services for people with dementia * To provide and to secure the provision of high quality services for carers of people with dementia.

feeds.title: Alzheimer's Speaks Blog
feeds.description: Alzheimer's erases memories and takes the power of speech with it, preventing people with the disease from expressing their needs and wants. Alzheimer's Speaks is a mouthpiece for those silenced. It also serves as an outlet for caregivers and loved ones too overwhelmed to have their say.

feeds.title: Alzheimer's Research & Prevention Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Alzheimer's Research and Prevention Foundation (ARPF) is a charitable organization dedicated to the prevention of Alzheimer's disease by funding research studies and providing educational outreach and memory screenings. The ARPF has been on the leading edge by researching, advocating, and educating for a holistic or integrative approach to preventing memory loss and Alzheimer's. Visit our blog for the latest news & updates.

feeds.title: Alzheimers Association of Northern California and Northern Nevada Blog
feeds.description: The Alzheimer's Association is the leading voluntary health organization in Alzheimer care, support and research. Our mission is to eliminate Alzheimer's disease through the advancement of research; to provide and enhance care and support for all affected; and to reduce the risk of dementia through the promotion of brain health.

feeds.title: Early On Set Blog
feeds.description: Early onset Alzheimer's only affects about 5 percent of people who develop Alzheimer's and begins prior to 65 years of age. When it happened to the husband of blogger Linda Fisher in 2008, she was inspired to launch a blog that provides wisdom, support, heartfelt stories, and practical advice for people who have Alzheimer's as well as their caregivers.

feeds.title: The Memories Project
feeds.description: A blog in memory of my father, raising Alzheimer's awareness & supporting caregivers. My goal was to collect all of the memories & stories I remembered about my dad, preserve them, and share them with others in hopes of encouraging them to document their own family history. I hope The Memories Project serves as inspiration for others to gather & preserve memories and stories of their loved ones now because you never know when it will be too late.

feeds.title: Allan S. Vann Blog
feeds.description: This site is a work-in-progress designed for visitors to read one or more of my published articles dealing with Alzheimer's.

feeds.title: Alzheimer's Queensland Blog
feeds.description: Read news and blog posts related to Dementia and get to know the stories of people experiencing Alzheimer's disease. Alzheimer's Queensland (AQ) is Australia's largest dementia association. Our mission at AQ is to work collectively with our clients, to maintain their dignity, remain socially and physically active, and deter their premature placement in residential facilities.

feeds.title: Alzheimer's News Today
feeds.description: Alzheimer's News Today is the Web's Daily Resource for Alzheimer's News. It is a digital platform intended to provide the Alzheimer's disease community with the most recent news and information on the disease, as well as first-hand community perspectives from other patients and caregiver columnists.

feeds.title: Société Alzheimer de Montréal Blog
feeds.description: The Alzheimer Society of Montreal blog provides information about the disease and its evolution, as well as resources for caregivers and health care professionals. Our mission is to alleviate the social and personal consequences of Alzheimer's disease and related disorders through the development and delivery of leading-edge intervention, care and support services in Montreal.

feeds.title: Alz MindFL Blog
feeds.description: Here you can find resources, tips and more from the Alzheimer's Association in Florida. The Alzheimer's Association leads the way to end Alzheimer's and all other dementia, by accelerating global research, driving risk reduction and early detection, and maximizing quality care and support.

feeds.title: Alzheimer's Research UK
feeds.description: Alzheimer's Research UK is leading dementia and Alzheimer's disease research charity. Find out about Alzheimer's Research UK, our journey so far, and our vision of a world where people are free from the fear, harm, and heartbreak of dementia.

feeds.title: Loving and Living Alzheimer's
feeds.description: Melissa and Randy K. live in Ceres, California. Married in 2006. Randy was diagnosed with Early Onset Alzheimer's in 2018, at 51 years of age. Between them, they have 3 children and 2 Grandchildren. This is their journey. Raising awareness and documenting the journey and loss.

feeds.title: Us Against Alzheimers Blog
feeds.description: UsAgainstAlzheimer's is a national advocacy campaign and independent advocacy network committed to stopping Alzheimer's by 2020. By joining this movement, you will be working to advance policies to prevent, treat and cure Alzheimer's disease in our lifetime.

feeds.title: My Journey with Alzheimer's
feeds.description: Hello there! Welcome to My Journey With Alzheimer's Blog. I was diagnosed with Early Stage Early Onset Alzheimer's on July 20, 2016. In this blog, I write all about my experience as the 'Early stage Alzheimer's'.

feeds.title: Truthful Loving Kindness
feeds.description: A blog by the person with dementia symptoms. In this blog, I will primarily focus on dementia symptoms, strategies, communication, and relationship from a 1st-person perspective. I also regularly discuss the role that spirituality plays in my daily life.

feeds.title: Living in the Shadow of Alzheimer's Blog
feeds.description: When Sheri's husband, Bob, was diagnosed with Alzheimer's and frontal lobe dementia, she felt as if a new and unwelcome visitor had permanently moved in with them. She named that visitor 'Al.' Her blog posts chronicle what it's like living with both her husband and his uninvited guest. Ranging from one-sentence anecdotes to poems, each blog packs an emotional punch.

feeds.title: The CareGivers Depot Blog
feeds.description: I share tips for the caregiver from my caregiving journey with my mom who is suffering from Dementia. Let's work together to rid the world of Alzheimers

feeds.title: Jura Care Village Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to care for people living with Dementia in our home-like facilities, specifically designed to ensure that the desired outcome is 'living well with Dementia'. We maintain or enhance quality of life and optimal general well-being with passionate management, multi professional team services, compassion and respect.

feeds.title: Dementia Diaries: A Journey With Dementia
feeds.description: I created this page to share our journey of dementia with my mom, as well as to create a place of support, awareness and resource for others. Please follow my official blog to view all content I post.

feeds.title: Alzheimer's Coalition of Henderson County Blog
feeds.description: We are walking daily hand in hand giving support to the caregivers of Henderson County. We provide continuing education and services for caregivers touched by Alzheimer's Disease and other related dementias. Our mission is to provide support services for caregivers affected by Alzheimer's disease or related dementias. We offer respite services for caregivers of persons with a debilitating dise

feeds.title: Run for the Sun
feeds.description: Keep up with articles on our Journey Through Alzheimer's

feeds.title: Curing Alzheimer's Disease Blog
feeds.description: Curing Alzheimer's Disease is your place to review current research, theories, actual cases, and risk factors for Alzheimer's Disease

feeds.title: Aging Matters Inc. Blog
feeds.description: Aging Matters (AMI) provides Alzheimer, dementia and elder care in Orange County, CA and the San Francisco Bay Area.

feeds.title: Alzheimers Clinics Blog
feeds.description: Find out about the treatments used for Alzheimer's Disease with the Alzheimer's Clinics Blog. The Alzheimer's Clinic website is designed to provide information about TPS and advertise UK TPS clinics. NeuroPulse TPS (or Transcranial Pulse Stimulation) is a new breakthrough intervention for mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease.

feeds.title: The Long and Winding Road…
feeds.description: Her mother's 10-year battle with Alzheimer's inspired blogger Ann Napoletan to launch a second career as an advocate for those with dementia as well as for their families. Through her blog, she seeks to support others with news on research and practical tips. Ann Napoletan uses her personal experience to help others touched by this disease.

feeds.title: Memories From My Life Blog
feeds.description: Blogger Pat White has been building a community of readers since 2009. That's when she began caring for her mother, who was diagnosed with Alzheimer's in 2007. Her tips and insights for adult children like a poster she made for her mother featuring images of family members, to help trigger happy memories are especially helpful for those whose loved one resides in a memory care community.

feeds.title: Alzheimer's Universe Blog
feeds.description: This website was created to offer the most up-to-date Alzheimer's disease (AD) information to educate family members and caregivers, and provide help for people with mild memory loss due to AD. Learn about AD prevention and treatment through lessons created by a team of experts.

feeds.title: Alzheimer's Association Blog
feeds.description: The Alzheimer's Association is the leading voluntary health organization in Alzheimer care, support and research. Our mission is to eliminate Alzheimer's disease through the advancement of research; to provide and enhance care and support for all affected; and to reduce the risk of dementia through the promotion of brain health. Our vision is a world without Alzheimer's disease.

feeds.title: Alzheimer's Association Washington State Chapter Blog
feeds.description: Alzheimer's Association Washington State Chapter is the premiere resource in Washington and Northern Idaho for people impacted by Alzheimer's. Our mission is to eliminate Alzheimer's disease through the advancement of research, to provide and enhance care & support for all affected, and to reduce the risk of dementia through the promotion of brain health. Read our blog for the latest stories and updates.

feeds.title: Alzheimer's & Dementia Weekly
feeds.description: This blog offers a unique community of people who all share the experiences of dementias such as Alzheimer's, whether as people with this handicap, professionals, caregivers, family or friends. We are dedicated to help preserve the dignity of patients and caregivers who are struggling with dementias.

feeds.title: Alzheimer's Disease International Blog
feeds.description: Alzheimer's Disease International (ADI) is the global voice on dementia. ADI's vision is an improved quality of life for people with dementia and their families throughout the world. They aim to help establish and strengthen Alzheimer associations throughout the world and to raise global awareness about Alzheimer's disease and all other causes of dementia.

feeds.title: Alzheimer's Texas Blog
feeds.description: Alzheimer's Texas provides information, referrals, and a variety of support programs for those with Alzheimer's disease and related dementias, and their family members, caregivers and professionals. To eliminate Alzheimer's disease and related disorders through the advancement of research and to enhance care and support for individuals, their families, and caregivers.

feeds.title: Alzheimers.net Blog
feeds.description: Alzheimers.net is an online community dedicated to advocacy, education and supporting those whose lives have been impacted by Alzheimer's disease and other forms of dementia. Get the latest dementia and Alzheimer's information, news, research, treatment options, caregiver stories and community support.

feeds.title: Illinois Chapter Blog
feeds.description: Read the stories from the Alzheimer's Association Illinois Chapter. The Alzheimer's Association leads the way to end Alzheimer's and all other dementia, by accelerating global research, driving risk reduction and early detection, and maximizing quality care and support. The Alzheimer's Association Illinois Chapter is the leading volunteer health organization in Alzheimer's disease care.

feeds.title: Alzheimer's Research Association Blog
feeds.description: The Alzheimer's Research Association Blog provides information related to the Alzheimer's disease and tells you about care options and other tips as well. The Alzheimer's Research Organization is committed to researching and compiling the most current information relevant to helping caregivers more effectively support Alzheimer's patients.
